query: What conditions allow authorities to get you to write your name on a piece of paper?
reference_answer:
1. Can police force me to sign any document?
No, the police cannot force you to sign any document. You have the right to read and understand the contents before signing.
answer: Authorities can legally require you to write your name on a piece of paper under certain conditions, such as when issuing official documents, conducting security checks, or in legal proceedings. [System]
